title: Require explicit reconciliation of every definition head
preconditions: A separate case r1 exists; prepare two valid concurrent revisions r2 and r2b from r1.

steps.action: Attempt a parentless revision; inspect concurrent heads; attempt reconciliation naming only r2, then retry naming both heads.
steps.expected_result: Parentless/incomplete-head requests are refused, concurrent heads have no current revision, and explicit complete reconciliation yields current r3.

expected_result: Require explicit reconciliation of every definition head.
